story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain on the measured clock, not observed. The camera's display pans the land and smoke rises in it. The view pulls back to the tower. Sixteen rings light and 16 installed stamps, and 56 planned pins. The display finds the same fire and flags it. The alert card leaves the display and lands on the cab's dash phone. The dash clock window opens and the estimate pins. The plume burns under Doesn't prevent fires. A heavier line from the truck stops clearly short of the responder badge as Can share pins below the gap. The wildfire lead reports no major fire since launch over a readable visor calendar with the attribution below it. The blank record keeps its How much sooner label whole. The plan folder arrives, Expected January 2027 pins, and the composite closes the film.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the tower camera sees and ends with the alert landed at the crew, the line toward responders open and the plan awaiting state approval.
story_review.weakest_transition: s4-shot-2 to s5-shot-1: from the dash clock in the cab straight back into the lens display with no physical bridge.
